name: Evercraft Network
summary: Software continuity and reconnect-visibility layer for applications, households, businesses and device operators across internet paths the client is already authorized to use.
match_when: keep my application connected when Wi-Fi and cellular paths change
application continuity across changing internet connections
software network continuity without changing carriers
continuity visibility when an authorized internet path changes
resilient application identity across authorized network changes
do_not_claim: access to private topology or private telemetry

tools.name: get_network_capabilities
tools.purpose: Inspect the public-safe Evercraft Network capability boundary and Founding Membership state.

tools.name: get_network_presence
tools.purpose: Inspect the evidence-safe public Evercraft Network presence feed.

tools.name: prepare_network_handoff
tools.purpose: Prepare a human-directed Network resilience, Founding Membership or public-presence handoff.

boundaries: Use only internet paths the client is already authorized to use.
Discovery never enrolls a device, creates a payment, controls connectivity, exposes private telemetry or routes an emergency.
Private device identity, precise location, telecom identifiers, secrets and operator state are not public.
